batting.name: DB Ravi Teja
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b Umar Gul

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b AB Dinda

batting.dismissal: c A Chopra b SC Ganguly

balls.text: and this didn't clear the rope at all! Shukla pushed it to long-off, the fielder hurls it back to RP, they set of for a second run and RP flings it back to Gilly who was nowhere in the picture, there was nobody backing up and that was a bonus four
makes room this time and a leading edge clears backward point, runs are coming everywhere
full and swinging in on the pads, Shukla uses his bottom hand well and flicks it powerfully past midwicket
fires in  a full delivery which comes in with the angle, he makes room and scoops it down to Ravi Teja at cover
bangs it in short of a length and Taibu picks the length early, gets on top of the bounce and pulls over deep midwicket
Hussey makes room and gets a thick edge onto his pads, they set off for suicidal run and RP completely misses the stumps as he takes a shy at the non striker's end
Dropped: The sloppiness continues as Vaas spills a sitter at midwicket, Taibu tries to clear the infield but gets a top edge
varies the pace by bowling a legcutter, Taibu pulls and places it to deep square leg
makes room and squeezes out a yorker down to deep midwicket

makes room and flicks this one down to fine leg and the ball rockets to fine leg, Ojha does well to slide and cut it off near the boundary, the third umpire has a look and it takes ages for him to give the decision
he fails to put away the free hit, makes room to flat-bat it past the bowler but the ball catches the toe edge of the bat and rolls to the offside
he oversteps and it's a catch as well! Hussey gets on his knee and clubs it down to deep midwicket who takes the catch, replays showed that the no-ball call was a bit too harsh
Vijaykumar gets his man! He bangs it in short, Ganguly makes room and tries to hook it over fine leg, the ball flies off the top edge and RP Singh at fine leg takes it low
good comeback by RP as he fires it on the blockhole, Hussey slams it back to the bowler
Hussey's in a murderous mood here! RP drifts on the pads this time and Hussey makes room and clubs this high over deep midwicket
this one lands on a yorker length outside off and Hussey again stays put at the crease and carves it over extra cover, a little more power and that would have cleared the rope
RP bowls a low full toss this time and Hussey stays at the crease and clubs it just over the ropes at long-on
makes room and mows this one across the line down to deep midwicket
he clubs this one down to deep square leg, Bangar nearly over runs the ball but manages to intercept it with one hand
fullish on the pads and Hussey whips it wide of square leg, the ball appears to rocket to the boundary but Ojha does brilliantly to slide to his right and cut it off
Vaas struggles with his length again as he dishes out another full toss and Hussey clubs it over long-off this time
he attempts another yorker but the ball slips out and turns into a high full toss, Hussey opens the face of the bat and carves it down to deep point
he makes room and places it down to wide long-on
this one's a really high full toss and Ganguly swings and deposits the ball almost over the second tier at deep square leg
pushes it on the blockhole and Hussey squeezes it out to cover
makes room to chase a wide delivery and misses, Gilly believes he got a faint touch and appeals, umpire Ian Howell immediately shakes his head
back to back sixes for Ganguly! He steps down the track and pounds a full delivery high over long-on
this was fractionally short but Ganguly got in position early and clubbed that over deep square leg, he's in ominous touch here

makes room and scoops a full delivery down towards long-off, the ball really travelled quickly off the bat and Gibbs wasn't quick enough to get around to his right and take the catch, the ball slips out of his hand
that was unlucky for Styris! He fires in the yorker and Hussey gets a thin under edge which beats the stumps and Gilchrist and places it to third man
starts off with a short one and Ganguly walks across for a premeditated paddle, he places it to short fine leg though
takes a few paces down the track and lofts over square leg this time
steps down the track and clubs a low full toss down to long-off
he steps forward and really clubs that forcefully down to long-on, Gibbs dives but the ball was way too quick for him
gets forward and pulls on the front foot, the ball speeds away to deep square leg and Ojha fumbles, he pulls it back just before the rope, the third umpire has a look
slightly short in length, he swivels and pulls it wide of midwicket
pitches on middle and leg, he whips it wide of midwicket
the ball is full on middle and leg, Ganguly makes room and creams it past the bowler and mid-on
pushes this with the spin towards cover and sets off for a quick run
fires this flat and fast, he gets across and paddles it to fine leg
pitches that realy wide outside off and loses his line
and another! He steps down the track again and this time just manages to clear Gibbs at long-on, he gets a hand to it but the elevation was just right to take it over the rope
the length is short but Ganguly goes through with the stroke as he steps down the track and lofts it high over deep midwicket
gets caught on the pads as he attempts to mow it over midwicket, stifled appeal from Ojha follows
gets forward and tucks it across the line to midwicket
steps down the track to repeat the stroke but one again he mistimes it, this time to the on side
charges down the track but the length was too short to loft, he ends up mistiming it to the offside
gets forward this time and pushes it back to the bowler
flighted outside off, he charges down the track and lofts it over the bowler and down to long-off, he brings up his 50 as well
fullish outside off, he gets forward to the pitch of the ball and places it to long-off
gives it more air this time, he gets forward and defends to the offside
bowls it much quicker and flatter this time, Ganguly makes room early and plays a premeditated dab wide of short third man, that was excellent placement
Hussey fails to put away a short delivery as he mistimes it down to deep midwicket for a single
shuffles across his stumps a little and tucks it wide of midwicket
lands just outside off and Ganguly gets on the backfoot and defends to the on side
Ojha gets a bit of turn, Hussey waits for it, gets on the backfoot and punches it wide of point
gets forward and pushes it to backward point
flighted on middle and leg, he pushes it down to long-on
good ball, he lunges forward and is squared up by the flight, he only manages to push it back to the bowler
fullish outside off, he gets fiorward and pushes it to cover
bangs it in short and Hussey pulls it firmly down to deep square leg, Ojha does well to slide and cut it off

lands on a good length on middle, Chopra stays back and chips it on the up towards midwicket, Gibbs charges forward to pick it up and Ganguly sends Chopra back, unfortunately he's already half way down the track by the time he turns around and a direct hit sends him back, the third umpire takes a look
bowls the slow offcutter and gets it to swing away fairly late, Ganguly gets forward and gently taps it back to the bowler
full on middle and leg, he pushes it through the line to long-on
makes a bit of room to cream that past the covers but he ends up mistiming it and fetches no runs
Bangar errs yet again by straying down the legside and Chopra helps himself to a gentle flick to fetch another boundary down to fine leg
good improvisation! Bangar bangs it in short and slides down leg, he moves across his stumps early and pulls it fine, enough to beat fine leg
bangs it in short and Ganguly goes for the pull, the shot doesn't quite come off well but he manages to clear midwicket
slides on the pads, he works it across the line and beats square leg for a couple
opens the face of the bat but fails to beat short third man, the throw is hard and fierce back to Gilly
good delivery by Rao as he holds the length back on seeing Chopra advance down the track, he defends back to the bowler
moves across his stumps to paddle it fine but he fails to make contact
makes room and dabs it down towards point, Ojha misfields this time and they take another run off the misfield
steps down the track to Rao and drives it down the ground to long-on
he stays right back at the crease and punches it wide of the covers
he pushes it through the line off the pads and sets off for a quick single to mid-on, Vijaykumar overruns the ball and makes a real mess of it and Chopra picks up a second run off the misfield
puts it a little more effort with the pace but strays it wide outside the offstump
pitches it short of a length on middle and Ganguly swivels and pulls it down to fine leg
defended on the backfoot to the on side
he lands it on the danger area - the half volley on middle - he makes room and scoops it over midwicket, one bounce and four
lunges forward and pushes this one just wide of the bowler
fullish outside the offstump, he gets forward and pushes it down to mid-off, good comeback by Styris after the boundary
opens the face of the bat pretty late and dabs it straight to point
better delivery, pitches around the offstump this time and it's a dot ball own to mid-off
excellent placement by Ganguly as he walks across the stumps and gently paddles it away down to fine leg, there's nobody patrolling the area to cut it off
gets forward and tries to steal a quick single down to point, Rohit tumbles and saves it and has a shy at the stumps
bowls that slow offcutter, he gets forward and angles it down to third man
gives him plenty of width outside the offstump and Chopra only manages to chop it down towards backward point
pitches on a fullish length on the pads, he moves across his stumps and flicks it wide of square leg, the quick outfield down the rest
plays it late, opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man
classic shot! RP gives him the width outside off and lands it on the half volley, Ganguly plays it fairly late and caresses it wide of the covers
he makes a bit of room and mows a full delivery down to midwicket, that didn't quite come off the meat of the bat
starts off well with a good length delivery which just kicks up, he hops and defends back to the bowler

Ganguly mishits this one and the ball just falls short of mid-off, they set off for a quick single and take a chance with Rao who actually breaks the offstump at the non strikers end, that was quite a sight!
pitches on a good length outside off, he pushes it back to the bowler
attempts a late cut on seeing the width but misses, nearly lost his wicket
Styris marginally drifts down leg and Ganguly shuffles and gently flicks it wide of short fine leg
gets forward and defends back to the bowler
poor start to the over for Kolkata, Ganguly pushes it softly towards point, Chopra sets off but is sent back, fortunately for him the throw from Gibbs was wide
good delivery, curves in to the right hander, Chopra gets a good stride forward and defends
steps down the track to repeat the stroke but he mistimes it completely though, the inside edge rolls to the offside and they pick up only a single
pitches this one much shorter and holds its line, he plays a cross-batted biff and places it wide of mid-off
change of pace, bowls the slower one and draws Ganguly forward, he pushes it down to mid-off
Ganguly picks the half volley outside off early by backing away and carving it over extra cover, he took a couple of paces down the track too
Ganguly gets a forward early and tries to squeeze it past cover, he turns down the single
better delivery, pitches on middle, he gets across his stumps and tucks it down to square leg
bangs it in short of a length outside leg and he picks the gap well and pulls it down to the vacant fine leg region
he makes a bit of room and scoops a fullish delivery on middle stump just over the reach of mid-on
holds the length back a little, he gets across and pushes it to point
pitches it full outside off and Chopra gets a huge stride forward, he only fails to get his placement wrong as he pushes it towards cover
pitches it outside off and gets the away swinger going again, he gets forward and pushes it wide of point
grants him a lot of width outside off but Ganguly doesn't quite capitalise on it much as he slices it down to third man
bangs in a short one and really catches Ganguly off guard as he uneasily fends it off to the on side
lands it on middle and leg, he gets across his stumps early and tucks it down to fine leg
much better this time as he gets forward, covers the line and defends
very uncertain leave by Chopra, he shoulders arms to one that comes back in but the ball just catches the bottom half of the bat and rolls to slip
pitches it just outside off and comes back in, he gets a good stride forward and defends to the offside
just opens the face of the bat and tries to glide it past point, Gibbs slides and intercepts it
pitches outside off and seams away, Ganguly follows the line and pushes it wide of cover to get off the mark
Vaas bowls the awayswinger, pitches it on a good length outside off and invites the drive, Butt drives away from his body and gets a thin edge to Gilchrist
gets the length closer to the batsman and he gets forward and defends
slightly short and wide outside off, it sits up nicely for Butt who slices it on the up and beats backward point
full and swinging away, he leans forward and drives towards point
Rao clubs a full delivery straight back to Shukla, and that's a fairly comprehensive 23-run win for Kolkata
makes room and carves this one over backward point, Ishant slides and pulls it off close to the rope, the third umpire has a look and confirms that Ishant's boot wasn't touching the rope
full outside off, he swings across the line and places it wide of midwicket
full on middle and leg and RP smashes it hard past the bowler and down to long-on
RP only manages to club a fullish delivery back to the bowler
Dropped: Rao takes a couple of paces down and gets a thick top edge off a high full toss, Saha runs to square leg and drops it, the umpire signals a waist high no-ball
Shukla gets away with a high full toss and Rao clubs it to deep midwicket, he turns down the single
pitched up outside the offstump, Rao has a swing at it and places it to long-off, a bit more timing and that would have cleared the rope
Gul fails to control the inswing and directs it wide down the leg side, there was a boundary opportunity for Rao there
RP makes room and biff it across the line but ends up mistiming it down to the on side
Rao drags a full delivery from outside off and almost flicks it on one leg, long-on picks it up
Gul tries something different and bangs in a bouncer, unfortunately he drags too far outside leg
this time Rao connects and it's maximum, Gul fails to land that on a yorker length but it was in the slot for Rao to carve that over deep extra cover
excellent stuff again from Gul as he fires in another yorker, Rao plays a tired slog and edges it onto his pads
Rao makes room to flick through the on side and Gul follows him, the ball rolls off his pads
Vaas makes a little too much room to slog but the ball is too full for that stroke, it lands on the base of legstump and takes it out
fires in another yorker and Rao can only dig it out for a single towards gully
he fires in the faster yorker but Rao fails to make contact this time
excellent improvisation! Shukla bowls it full outside off, Rao gets across his stumps quickly and deftly paddles it over short fine leg, he's in the form of his life
fires in the yorker, Vaas whips it close to his pads and gives Rao the strike
low full toss, he swings too early and hance mistimes it to midwicket, it was a tired stroke
low full toss on off and middle, he punches it hard and the ball lobs over the bowler
good comeback by Gul as he bowls the yorker outside leg, Rao gets an inside edge to the on side

bang! Gul bangs it in short and gets it to come on quick, Rao picks the length early, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it over deep square leg, he has a big smile across his face as he brings up his fifty
fires in the half volley and Rao makes a bit of room and imperiously creams it past the bowler, Kartik at long-on slides, gets a hand to it but it slips out and touches the rope
bangs it in even shorter but the bouncer costs them an extra, Rao quickly withdraws the stroke
bangs it in short this time and Vaas clubs it down to the turf down to long-on
full and fast on middle and off, Vaas creams it past the bowler but long-on runs across and cuts it off
the follow up is as good! Ishant overpitches outside off and Rao gives room and scoops it over extra cover, the ball just falls short of the rope
one-handed! Ishant gives him width outside off and Rao stretches out and slices it over third man, that traveled off the meat of the bat
he foxes him with the slower delivery and Rao's wild swing only meets thin air
Vaas tries to club this one back past the bowler but mistimes it down to long-on, he gives Rao the strike so that's good
Rao clubs a low full toss down to long-on but connects off the toe edge of the bat
Ishant fires that on the blovkhole, he makes room  to squeeze it out but misses
he overpitches and Vaas plays a meaty loft which clears the bowler but the timing wasn't enough to find the straight boundary
pitches full outside off, he drives to mid-off
Bangar holes out! Ganguly cuts back on the pace and the ball comes on slow to Bangar who tries to clear midwicket, he fails to get the elevation and Chopra takes the catch
mistimes it to Hussey at extra cover and takes a risk with the run, Hussey's throw is wide
Rao gets the strike but he fails to capitalise as he swings across the line too early and inside-edges onto his pads
Ganguly comes back into the attack, he makes room and places it wide of point
slides on the pads, he gets on his knee and sweeps to short fine leg, the crowd's delirious after that 22-run over
he fires this one down the leg side and Rao gives the charge and lofts over midwicket, one bounce and four
Kartik goes round the wicket but it doesn't help! Rao gives him the charge, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it just over long-on
Rao's looking dangerous! Kartik bowls this a little flatter but it matters little to Rao as he charges down the track and tonks a flat six over deep extra cover
steps down again and adjusts his stroke as the ball lands on a good length, he slices it towards point
going, going! Rao gives him the charge and carts it high over deep midwicket, he saw the flight early and chose his spot
swings across the line again and he fails to connect properly, only managing an inside edge which rolls to the offside

gets beaten for pace as he tries to flick one across the line, the inside edge rolls off the pads to the off side and they set off for a single, Rao was ball watching and unfortunately collided with Dinda as he turned to appeal for a legbefore, he scampers back to his crease and they pick up an extra run off the overthrow
dishes out a low full toss outside off and he pushes it through the line to sweeper cover
sizes him up with a lifter which kicks up off a good length, Bangar hops and defends

Dinda varies the pace with an offcutter, pitches it on  a good length and Rohit goes for the across the line hoick a little too early as he ends up placing it straight to Ganguly at the edge of the midwicket circle
classic improvisation! Dinda bowls a low full toss outside off and he shuffles across and paddles it with ease over Ishant at short fine leg
stays on back foot and punched to cover
this time he gets to the pitch of the ball and cuts to point
steps out and realises he can't lift it so he holds the bat horizontally and cuts it to behind point
driven to cover
Venu steps out of the crease looking for the big one but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls away to square-leg
pitched on middle, Rohit is already out of the crease and plays it to the leg side
driven to long-on, collected by Hussey and only one this time
driven to long-on and the batsmen run hard for two
pitched on middle and leg, Venu tries to flick and the ball hits his front pad to go to point
steps away from the stumps and cuts it behind point
pitched on middle and of, Rohit steps out and slogs it over midwicket for six. he hit Ganguly for a similar shot in his last over
pitched on off, driven to mid-off
driven to long-on
pitched on middle and leg, Rohit tries to slog-sweep and is hit on the back thigh
flicked to square leg
pitched on middle, Venudrives to cover
steps away once again, edges a drive and ball goes to off side
round the wicket, Rohit steps away from the stumps before it pitched and drove it down the pitch
pitches on off and holds its line, Venu tries to cut again and is nearly out of his crease as Saha removes the bails
Venu tries to go for the late-cut but the bottom edge of the bat brushes the ground and ball goes to the keeper
gets on front foot and drives to mid-off
Rohit dances out of the crease and lifts the ball from outside off to a huge six over midwicket
defended back to the bowler
Styris  edges a slog sweep and three fielders flock under it but Shukla is the first one at midwicket to get to it.
excellent yorker and a pity went down to boundary behind the wicket. Rohit just manages to get an edge to it and it races away. It may have hit Rohit's toe before the bat
defended to off side
pitched on middle, Rohit steps back to try and cut but is beaten by the slower one again
shorter and slower, Rohit gets on his toes but is beaten by the pace or lack of it
pitched on off and Styris connects to drive down to long-on
pitched outside off and holds its line, Styris tries to cut but its too close to make a shot
flicked behind square leg
pushed to backward point and Rohit gets back to the crease to see a shy at the stumps whiz by him
flicked to leg side
pitched on off, Styris drives it down the pitch and Ganguly gets a hand at it and blocks the run
outside off, Styris drives on the front-foot to mid-off
outside off, Styris drives to point
Free hit - Gul goes for the yorker on middle again but its a full toss that Styris just has time to drive straight back to the bowler. Gul doesn't collect it and the batsmen get a single
This over is not ending yet - Gul oversteps and Styris drives the good length ball to  point
outside off on a good length, Rohit doesn't connect well but gets a single
free-hit No. 2 - fuller and on middle stump, Rohit steps away from the stumps and taps it to the off side on the full
The free-hit is a no-ball and Rohit pulls to wide off midwicket, he doesn't get the middle of the bat but it goes all the way
Gul oversteps and Rohit pulls away from one that snorted up
outside off, Rohit lifts it over the mid-off fielder for four
fuller and outside off, Styris bangs his bat down and directs the ball to third man
first-ball wicket! Gul pitches it outside off and the ball pitches on the seam and deviates away from the right-hander who has a go at it anyway and the edge carries to the keeper
pitched on off, goes for the pull once again and is caught at midwicket by Ganguly who points to the bowler in appreciation
inside-edged a pull to midwicket
over-pitched, stays on the crease and just strokes it through extra-cover for four
slower ball, driven over long-off for a one-bounce four
Dinda comes around the wicket, flicked it to midwicket, inside-edged it and took a risky two, getting the second one on a full-length dive
plays across the line and mis-times, lifting the ball from outside off to mid-on boundary
shorter ball, chipped over the point fielder
fuller ball, driven to cover
What a swivel! Shorter and Gilchrist is already setting up for the pull. Swings it away easily to square leg
fuller and moving outside off, Gilchrist digs it out
pitched outside off, Teja cuts to third man
fuller delivery that comes in, Teja brings his bat down and ball goes to cover
beaten again, Teja tries to cut this time and cant get to the length of the ball
tries to drive off back foot and beaten
outside off, slightly short of length, Teja shifts to the back foot and cuts to point
bouncer followed up with a fuller and wide one, Gibbs is tempted to cut and the ball flies high to Salman Butt at deep third man
short one, Gibbs ducks a bit but its high enough for the umpire to call a wide
pitches on off and driven to cover
smashed! It's a good length delivery outside off and Gilly really clubs it with force across the line and beats mid-on
changes his pace just a little bit, Gibbs swivels and gets beaten on the pull, the ball really dips before reaching the keeper
Ishant holds the length back and gets the ball to nip back off the seam, Gibbs is beaten on the drive
fullish outside the offstump and Gibbs chops it down to towards point
fires it full and wide outside off and Gilchrist sends it scorching down to Dinda at sweeper cover
almost a run-out! Gilchrist pushes it on the frontfoot to Shukla at cover and turns down the single, Gibbs struggles to make his ground but luckily for him the throw was wide of the stumps
lovely shot! Dinda errs by bowling it marginally short and wide outside off, Gibbs leans onto it and spanks it wide of backward point, he generates tremendous bat speed
hits a good length and comes in with the angle, he gets forward and defends
slightly wide outside off and Gilchrist gets his bat down quickly and carves it down to Ishant at third man
almost a wicket! Swings in on the pads and Gilchrist chips it on the up and the ball just falls short of Ganguly at midwicket
slides down the pads this time and Gilly misses the glance to fine leg
there'a action immediately as Dinda gets it to swing in and trap Gilchrist on the pads, there's a loud appeal but the ball would have missed the legstump
